description.default: We know losing a device is stressful. That's why we've made our claims process the fastest in the industry.

default.title: File a Claim 24/7
default.description: Visit this site or call us anytime. Most claims are approved instantly.

default.title: Pay Deductible
default.description: Pay your deductible via credit card. Deductibles range from $29 to $200 depending on device.

default.title: Get Reconnected
default.description: We'll repair your screen, or ship a replacement device to your door as soon as the next day.
